title: feat(objectql, runtime): action handlers keyed by (package, objectName, name)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi94iVCtTTWxJdCGE1yMbk32V)_

Fixes #31673
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none. No skill or doc names the handler key; `skills/objectstack-ai` describes `executeAction(object, target, ctx)` with no package, which is unchanged. ADR-0150 D4 already states the key.
Narrowing: (1) D3 (a), a package caller whose only holder on the object is an environment-authored action is refused naming the environment: 0 environment-authored action items in the four first-party compositions, and 0 reachable requests (no door passes a caller's package yet). (2) The outside-closure package holder (ruled on #31527, comment 6728487836): 0 first-party callers affected. Every first-party declaration resolves for its own package (showcase 72 of 72, crm 1, todo 8, multi-package has none); the only outside-closure refusals the census found are platform packages asking for an app's action (for example `plugin-auth` asking for `showcase_mark_done`), which no first-party caller does. Also 0 reachable requests today. The no-package call to a same-object pair is unchanged (below) and goes to the maintainer on #31697.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：动作引擎的处理器表改为按 (包, 对象, 动作名) 存放，两个包在同一对象上注册同名动作时两份都保留；指明包的调用跑自己包的处理器，路由器对指明包的调用经 R 的解析器 (ADR-0150 D3) 解析声明。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 D4 要求动作按包寻址；之前同对象同名的第二次注册会覆盖第一次，指明包的调用无从区分。
- 风险与回滚：不指明包的调用行为完全不变 (最后注册者运行、#24472 警告照旧)；目前没有任何入口传调用方包，所以线上请求零变化。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/engine-actions.ts` 的 `registerAction` / `packageScopedHandler`，以及 `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` 的 `resolveRouteActionByPackage`。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/objectql && npx vitest run src/action-package-addressing.test.ts src/bound-action-collision-report.test.ts`，再 `cd packages/runtime && npx vitest run src/action-package-addressing.test.ts`。
- 需要你做的：#31697 决定不指明包、同对象两包同名时是否改为 409 拒绝；本 PR 只钉住现状。

## What changes

**Engine (objectql).** `ObjectQL` keeps a second handler index, keyed by package coordinate then `OBJECT:NAME` (`packageActions`). `registerAction` places each registration in its owner's coordinate (`app:<id>` reads as `<id>`, a plugin id as itself, no owner and the authored-action resync as the environment's `''`), with the same override stacking as the unqualified slot (#30065, #30542). `executeAction(objectName, actionName, ctx, { packageId })` runs that package's own handler. If the package has none, it runs the one **shared** handler under the key: host code registered with no owner (the documented way a package binds its own target-bound actions, e.g. `examples/app-todo/src/actions/register-handlers.ts`) or a plugin's. Owner-less host code sits in its own coordinate (`HOST_ACTION_COORDINATE`), apart from the environment's (`''`, where the authored-action resync registers environment-authored actions as `metadata-service`). The fallback never reaches the environment's slot or another package's (`app:<id>`) handler. Two or more shared handlers are refused with 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming every owner (`ActionHandlerAmbiguityError`, unexported; compare `code`), never reported as "not found"; the `/actions` door answers it through its declared-status arm. `removeActionsByPackage` prunes both indexes. `registerActionOverride` binds in the base's coordinate. `listRegisteredActions({ packageId })` lists the handler a call naming that package dispatches under each key, with the coordinate whose slot holds it.

**The owner gate (review 6729902179 F2).** `actionHandlerOwnerRefusal` takes the dispatch's `packageId` and judges the handler that call runs (the package-keyed listing) instead of the unqualified slot's. A declaration known to belong to another package (its `_packageId` stamp) reaches a different handler under the same key and no longer gates the call. A declaration whose package is not known, and every declaration reaching a shared handler, still gates it, as on the unqualified path, so nothing loosens.

**The #31697 interim (ruling 6728550494).** The unqualified slot is untouched: a call with no `packageId` runs the last registration under `OBJECT:NAME`, and the replacement is still warned naming both owners. The code comment at that branch cites #31697. Pinned by `[#31697 interim] a call that names no package keeps today's answer exactly` (objectql) and `[#31697 interim] a caller that names no package` (runtime).

**Declaration (objectql + runtime).** `resolveActionByPackage` runs R's `resolvePackageScopedName` over an owner-scoped view of the registry (`actionOwnerScopedRegistry`: the `action` holders whose owner key is the routed object, else the object-less ones). R keys `(type, name)`, so the view is what makes two packages' `approve` on two objects two names that never meet. There is no second resolver; the steps, closure and refusals are R's. A refusal on the object never falls through to an object-less holder. `resolveRouteActionDeclaration` takes an optional `callerPackageId`. Given one, it resolves through R first and reads a package holder's item back through the protocol's execution face qualified by that package (so a disabled package stays withheld, #25308). A refusal makes the `/actions` door answer 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with the candidates. Without `callerPackageId`, every rung is as before.

**Lean core.** The engine imports only `action-handler-coordinate.ts`, which has no resolver import, so the `./core` entry stays clear of `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (ADR-0076 D2; `core-boundary.ratchet.test.ts` green). The resolver-backed reads live in the runtime, per the epic seat's R2 #31716 note. No bindable or injected workaround was added.

## Acceptance notes

- Single holder, bare: unchanged for the engine (`executeAction` with no package), REST (`resolveRouteActionDeclaration` with no `callerPackageId`) and nav. Phase-1 parity is pinned: one holder gives the same item R's own read gives.
- Closure double holder: refused, naming both (objectql and runtime cases).
- Object-bound actions are distinguished by (package, objectName, name) in both the handler index and the declaration view.
- D3 (a): positive (no-package caller resolves the environment item) and negative (package caller refused naming the environment).
- **ActionNavItem route.** No ActionNavItem reader exists in objectql or runtime. The Console resolves `actionDef.actionName` through `GET /meta/action/NAME` and runs it through `/actions`. The package reaches that route through G1 #31691 (`/meta` qualified address, D5 409) and G3 #31695 (the Console's half; U #31671 is closed not_planned and its carriers moved there). This PR gives both the door half: pass `callerPackageId` and the declaration and the handler are the package's.
- MCP (`run_action`) is unchanged; its namespace is G2 #31692.

## Tests

New: `packages/objectql/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts` (13, real `SchemaRegistry`), the `ObjectQL action handlers keyed (package, objectName, name)` block in `packages/objectql/src/bound-action-collision-report.test.ts` (12), `packages/runtime/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts` (10, real `ObjectQL` and `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`).

Forced test changes: none. Every existing pin stays green, including the four handler-face cases in `bound-action-collision-report.test.ts` and the #30065/#30542 override cases in `plugin-authored-actions.test.ts`. `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` learned the new runtime test's row-store double, which routes `findOne` through `assertEngineFindOnePredicate` (written by `check-engine-double-contract.mjs --write`).

Suites on head `d65e2b13`: objectql 576 files / 11741 tests passed; runtime 567 files / 10421 passed, 19 skipped; rest 400 files / 7927 passed, 355 skipped. `tsc --noEmit` clean in objectql and runtime; eslint over both packages exit 0.

Dogfood battery (narrowing arm), head `d65e2b13`: os-verify-lock VERDICT command-exit 0 · Test Files 440 passed, 3 skipped (443) · Tests 3652 passed, 41 skipped (3693) · no failures.

Gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 78 commands on `d65e2b13`, all exit 0 (`check:type-check-debt` run under the verify lock); `--ran` reconciliation 78 derived, 78 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

### Ablations (each restored, `git diff HEAD` empty after)

| Put back | Read red |
|---|---|
| A1: a package call falls back to any one handler under the key, including another package's | 2: `withdrawing one package keeps the other's handler…`, `never runs another package's handler` (read at d49c1e0d) |
| A2: R on the registry's `(type, name)` key, with no owner-scoped view | 4: `…two objects never meet…`, `falls to the object-less holders only when…`, `a refusal on the object never falls through…`, `an object-less route resolves among the object-less holders only` |
| A3: a refusal on the object falls through to object-less holders | 5, including `refuses a caller whose closure holds the name on the object twice…`, both D3 (a)/outside-closure refusals, and `a refusal on the object never falls through…` |
| A4: the router drops R's refusal and takes the first-match rungs | 3 (runtime): closure double holder, outside-closure package, D3 (a) environment |
| B1 (epic item 1): two shared handlers answered as absence | 2: `a host handler and a plugin handler under one key are two candidates…`, `refuses 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT naming every owner when two plugins hold the key…` |
| C1 (epic item 2, F1): the resync's handlers in the host slot | 4, including `never runs the environment's handler (the authored-action resync) for another holder's declaration` |
| C2 (F1, host half): owner-less host code excluded from the fallback | 2: `reaches host code registered with no owner…`, `a host handler and a plugin handler under one key are two candidates…` |
| C3 (F2): the owner gate reads the unqualified listing for a package call | 1 (runtime): `a package call that runs its own handler is not gated by another package's declaration reaching the same key` |
| C4 (F2): the owner gate without the `_packageId` filter | the same runtime case |

### Review notes carried

- N1 (`coordinateOfUnqualified`'s identity loop never matches, so a no-`base` override names its own coordinate): accepted deviation; unreached, since the resync always passes `base`.
- N2: `IObjectQLEngine.executeAction` in `packages/spec` keeps three parameters while the dispatcher calls four on `ql: any`. The card forbids a spec edit; routed to G1.
- N3 (a package caller falls to the rungs when the registry view holds no item, which can serve an unhydrated environment row): accepted deviation; for G1 to pin or state.
- N4 (the ADR-0110 D5 inventory and the `hasRegisteredHandler` probe still read the unqualified slot): accepted deviation; no answer changes today.

### Same-object-pair census (ruling 6728550494: stop if non-zero)

I booted showcase, crm, multi-package and todo through `@objectstack/verify` on this branch and counted `OBJECT:NAME` handler keys held in two or more package coordinates, plus `action` declarations with the same (owner, name) under two or more holders. Every count was **0** (showcase: 62 handler keys, 72 declarations). The census was a scratch test and is not committed.
